meta.title: Lawrence County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Lawrence County's 2026 budget, set by Ordinance 2025-30 (November 10, 2025) and filed with the state. Office and fund amounts come from the ordinance; the categories come from the county's budget detail. The General Fund total includes $100,000 sent to the E-911 and Public Defender funds, so those dollars also appear in those funds.

nodes.name: County General Fund
nodes.note: Printed total is $5,807,975.87; the lines listed add to $5,810,985.87. The $3,010 gap matches Elections ($72,235) and Small Claims ($49,086.74) as shown in the summary on p. 46.

nodes.name: Small Claims
nodes.note: The ordinance appropriates $49,096.74; the categories in the budget detail (pp. 18–19) add to $49,086.74.

nodes.name: E-911 (transfer)
nodes.note: Listed inside the General Fund total; this money goes to fund 3020, which spends it, so it is counted twice. Article 6 (p. 55) lists this transfer as $75,000.00.

nodes.name: Public Defender (transfer)
nodes.note: Listed inside the General Fund total; this money goes to fund 3024, which spends it, so it is counted twice. Article 6 (p. 55) lists this transfer as $20,000.00.

nodes.name: Public Defender
nodes.note: The ordinance appropriates $33,300.00; the categories in the budget detail (pp. 26–27) add to $35,700.00.

nodes.name: Juvenile Court Grant
nodes.note: No budget detail pages for this fund; only the ordinance total.
